items.args: {"target": "character", "id": "6c364b1a1e8d", "text": "A man named Chris left those for you, though he did not mean to. He fought the goblin in this cave down to its last breath, and did not live to finish it."}

items.text: Spoke once, to Gavin alone: he thanked the sky for a dead man's gear, so I told him whose it was and that Chris left the goblin at one breath — the only fact about his "blessing" the world itself cannot tell him. Nothing else touched.
